03. My story so far

My journey

Each role has helped me grow into a more organised, confident, and people-focused professional. I have learned to stay dependable in busy environments, communicate with care, and make sure the details behind everyday work are handled properly.

Apr 2021 — Sep 2023

Staff at Watson

My first role gave me a strong foundation in customer service, teamwork, and daily operations. Working in a busy retail environment taught me to stay attentive, helpful, and calm while supporting customers and keeping responsibilities organised.

Sep 2023 — Sep 2026

Admin Staff at Happy Fish Swim School

This experience helped me develop my administrative strengths in a welcoming, people-centred environment. I supported communication and everyday coordination while learning how clear information, careful organisation, and a friendly approach can make things easier for families, students, and the wider team.

October 2026

Admin Executive at Hanamaru Trading Sdn Bhd

In my current role, I continue to build on my experience by taking a more structured approach to office administration and business support. I enjoy bringing order to busy days, keeping information clear, and helping work move forward with consistency and care.
